reply:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount_minor), 0) * 1.0
       / (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER) FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar')
FROM refunds
WHERE date(created_at) <= (SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'as_of_date');

       SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT products.id, products.category, products.name,
           SUM(order_items.quantity) AS units
    FROM products
    JOIN order_items ON order_items.product_id = products.id
    JOIN orders ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
    WHERE orders.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY products.id, products.category, products.name
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT category, name, units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT category, name, units
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, name;

       (orders.shipping_minor + COALESCE((
           SELECT SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_minor)

LIMIT 3;

GROUP BY customers.country

SELECT products.category,
       SUM(order_items.unit_price_minor * order_items.quantity) * 1.0
       / (SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS amount_dollars
FROM order_items
JOIN products ON products.id = order_items.product_id
GROUP BY products.category;

SELECT customers.segment,
       SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
WHERE orders.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY customers.segment;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT products.id, products.category, products.name,
           SUM(order_items.quantity) AS units
    FROM products
    JOIN order_items ON order_items.product_id = products.id
    JOIN orders ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
    WHERE orders.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY products.id, products.category, products.name
)
SELECT category, name, units
FROM product_sales
WHERE units = (
    SELECT MAX(units)
    FROM product_sales AS category_sales
    WHERE category_sales.category = product_sales.category
)
ORDER BY category, name, id;

    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_value
    FROM orders
    LEFT JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id

SELECT orders.id,
       (COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_minor), 0)
        + orders.shipping_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)
        FROM shop_meta
        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS total_dollars
FROM orders
LEFT JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
GROUP BY orders.id, orders.shipping_minor
ORDER BY COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_minor), 0)
         + orders.shipping_minor DESC, orders.id
LIMIT 3;

reply:
SELECT products.category,
       COALESCE(SUM(order_items.unit_price_minor * order_items.quantity), 0)
       / CAST((SELECT value FROM shop_meta WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS REAL) AS amount_dollars
FROM products
LEFT JOIN order_items ON order_items.product_id = products.id
GROUP BY products.category;

SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', delivered_at), COUNT(*)
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'delivered_complete'
  AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', delivered_at)
ORDER BY strftime('%Y-%m', delivered_at);

reply:
SELECT topic, ROUND(AVG(satisfaction), 2)
FROM tickets
WHERE satisfaction IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY topic
ORDER BY AVG(satisfaction), topic
LIMIT 1;

SELECT customers.name, COUNT(refunds.id)
FROM customers
LEFT JOIN orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
LEFT JOIN refunds ON refunds.order_id = orders.id
WHERE customers.country = 'NLD'
GROUP BY customers.id, customers.name;

       SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_minor) * 1.0 /
       (SELECT CAST(value AS INTEGER)

        WHERE key = 'minor_units_per_dollar') AS revenue_dollars
FROM customers

JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
WHERE orders.status = 'delivered_complete'
GROUP BY customers.segment;

WITH product_sales AS (
    SELECT products.category,
           products.name,
           SUM(order_items.quantity) AS units
    FROM products
    JOIN order_items ON order_items.product_id = products.id
    JOIN orders ON orders.id = order_items.order_id
    WHERE orders.status = 'delivered_complete'
    GROUP BY products.id, products.category, products.name
),
ranked_sales AS (
    SELECT category,
           name,
           units,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY units DESC) AS sales_rank
    FROM product_sales
)
SELECT category, name, units
FROM ranked_sales
WHERE sales_rank = 1
ORDER BY category, name;

reply:
SELECT customers.name, COUNT(*)
FROM customers
JOIN orders ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
WHERE orders.status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY customers.id, customers.name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 8;

reply:
SELECT topic,
       ROUND(AVG(JULIANDAY(DATE(resolved_at)) - JULIANDAY(DATE(opened_at))), 2)
FROM tickets
WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY topic;

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_minor), 0) AS merchandise_minor
    FROM orders
    LEFT JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
    GROUP BY orders.id
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM order_values
WHERE merchandise_minor > (SELECT AVG(merchandise_minor) FROM order_values);

reply:
SELECT orders.id,
       (COALESCE(SUM(order_items.quantity * order_items.unit_price_minor), 0)
        + orders.shipping_minor) * 1.0 / CAST(shop_meta.value AS INTEGER) AS total_dollars
FROM orders
LEFT JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id
JOIN shop_meta ON shop_meta.key = 'minor_units_per_dollar'
GROUP BY orders.id
ORDER BY total_dollars DESC, orders.id
LIMIT 3;
